TrainableDef.label: crafting
TrainableDef.description: The animal works near a monkey workshop: it equips a hammerstone to cut stone chunks into blocks, hauls distant chunks back to the bench, butchers small game with a stone knife, and makes kibble from meat and vegetables. Reserved for nimble-handed species: the monkey, in the base game. Stonecutting and butchery are each learned with experience (visible when selected): a novice learns twice as fast beside a working master of the same craft, a master stonecutter knaps its own hammerstone, a master butcher field-dresses game of any size, and any monkey with a hammerstone strikes fresh knives from a chunk.
